Pinned source: https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/tree/v1.3.4

Only the files needed for the x64 static build are included, with the upstream
BSD license. All included source files were compared against the official
v1.3.4 source archive on 2026-10-20 and match (allowing CRLF normalization).
No local modifications. Build directly from these sources; no downloaded
MinHook binary or separate dependency checkout is required.
